card.title: 432. INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 432nd Infantry Regiment was a unit of the 131st Infantry Division of the German Wehrmacht during WWII. The division was formed in 1940 and participated in Operation Barbarossa in 1941 as part of Army Group Center, in the Battle of Białystok–Minsk and the Battle of Kiev, but it was pushed back by the Soviet counter offensive during the Battle of Moscow. The division was transferred to Velikiye Luki in 1943 and participated in the Battle of Nevel that same year. In 1944, the division was ordered to hold the line at the town of Vitebsk, in what is now Belarus, but after continuous fighting it was driven into the Heiligenbeil Pocket in East Prussia (now part of Russia) where the division was destroyed by the Red Army forces in March 1945.
